##### MOMUS MUSEUMS

In November 2018, five museums, four based in Thessaloniki and one in Athens officially joined forces, creating a single, large, integrated public cultural institution, whose aspiration is to leave its mark on international modern and contemporary art, photography, sculpture and the experimental arts.

##### MOMUS MUSEUMS

In November 2018, five museums, four based in Thessaloniki and one in Athens officially joined forces, creating a single, large, integrated public cultural institution, whose aspiration is to leave its mark on international modern and contemporary art, photography, sculpture and the experimental arts.
